ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% low-intensity (black) to 35% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, high-intensity (white) contiguous blobs are positioned on the distal halves of both lobes. These regions contain high-frequency low-intensity (black) stippling and mottling concentrated near the superior margins. The proximal region surrounding the median notch is characterized by solid low-intensity (black) pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 35-40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) are present along the entire trailing edge. Amplitude of pixel variations is greatest on the distal outer thirds of the lobes, becoming more attenuated toward the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a concave curve from the distal tips to the central notch. The lateral tips exhibit a sharp posterior-lateral sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of small, roughly circular high-intensity pixel groups are densely mapped along the perimeter of the trailing edge and the distal lobe tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned vertical linear pixel disruptions (dark streaks) are visible across the high-intensity distal patch of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular margin degradation and serration along the trailing edge; significant high-intensity scarring present on the distal extremities of both lobes.
